title: The answer of the triage stage
description: Stage 0 of the pipeline. One cheap model call answering a single question: is this a parking sign. The model returns a LABEL, not a decision: whether the pipeline continues is decided by code.

category.description: The only field that affects the course of the pipeline. The threshold leans towards letting things through: anything doubtful is labelled parking_sign and goes on to be read, because discarding a real sign costs more than spending one extra call on rubbish.

what_i_see.description: One short phrase about what is in the photograph. Needed only for the answer shown to the user when triage stopped the reading. Does not enter the computation.

model_confidence.description: The model's own estimate. Kept for the measurement and grounds for no decision at all: on photograph 013 the model reported full certainty while losing the boundary between two plates.

panels_below_main_sign.description: How many plates below the main sign STATE A RULE - hours, duration, fee, who may park, an arrow, a number of spaces. Operator plates and payment boards do not count. It is asked here deliberately: this is an independent look at the same photograph, on a different call with a different prompt. Counting everything was tried, and the measurement showed that counting everything is exactly where the count falls apart: a payment board is a stack of stickers with no clear boundaries, and the model names their number at random. Now both sides count the same thing.
